assessments.note: v0.4.0 adds bounded Claude whole-plugin activation and new provider-surface qualification; focused negative tests and exact-provider qualification were added.
Dependency Review and cargo-deny remain release gates; SBOM/provenance are regenerated for exact release bytes.
Workflow changes remain pinned to immutable action SHAs and are covered by CI/CodeQL/release-readiness.
v0.4.0 introduces release-wide delta classification and explicit contract-evolution review in addition to existing artifact/SBOM/provenance gates.
Public claims are reviewed against exact behavior-specific qualification and the public-boundary gate.
New runtime behavior received regression/negative coverage; release-delta contract itself receives deterministic unit coverage.
This release establishes the first machine-enforced release-delta contract.

residuals: macOS release artifacts remain unsigned and unnotarized at the Apple platform-signing layer.
Linux, Windows and Intel macOS remain not qualified.
Claude whole-plugin activation is limited to the documented exact provider tuple and skill-only observed surface.
